skills.name: Occultism
skills.description: Working the humours as weapons. Trained by dealing occult damage.

skills.name: Butchering
skills.description: Taking carcasses apart at the right station with the right tool. Higher levels get more out of each one.

skills.name: Distillation
skills.description: Rendering galls and glands into the salts and tinctures occult workings burn. The Synod calls it a crime.
